question.text: What is the maximum shareholding a sponsor or its associate can hold in the AMC or trustee company of ANY OTHER mutual fund?

explanation.text: The Logic: No sponsor, associate, group company, or AMC may have 10% or more of the shareholding or voting rights in the AMC or trustee company of any other mutual fund, so the permitted holding is less than 10% (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.259). The Trap: 25% is the single-investor corpus limit referenced on p.246 in the context of scheme-level investor concentration, not the cross-mutual-fund shareholding limit. Note: Anchor on the source-backed less-than-10% rule from p.259 and the distinct 25% single-investor corpus limit from p.246.
